headline: U.S. Democratic Sweep Threatens Passage of the Crypto Clarity Act
summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.
why: Regulatory frameworks and legislation regarding digital assets and crypto markets heavily influence compliance costs, market access, and institutional participation in the United States.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Markets
impacts.why: Proposed regulatory scrutiny and potential failure of the Clarity Act directly impact crypto market operations.
